services.title: WordPress Development
services.tagline: WordPress websites built to be yours.
services.summary: Custom WordPress websites, Gutenberg and Elementor builds, and WooCommerce stores that are fast, flexible and easy to update.
services.intro: A website should be straightforward to manage long after launch. I build responsive WordPress experiences around clear layouts, sensible content structures and practical editing workflows, so the day-to-day updates stay in your hands.
benefits: Custom themes and responsive page builds
Custom post types, fields and reusable blocks

faq.question: Can I edit the website myself?
faq.answer: Yes. The goal is an editor-friendly website where you can change your content, images and pages without needing to edit code.

faq.question: Can you improve an existing WordPress site?
faq.answer: Yes. Existing themes, layouts, speed issues and WooCommerce changes can be reviewed before deciding whether to refine or rebuild.

services.title: Shopify Development
services.tagline: Online stores that make shopping feel simple.
services.summary: Shopify theme customization, storefront sections, product templates and conversion-focused eCommerce experiences.
services.intro: A Shopify store has to work for the customer and for the team updating it. From clean product discovery to flexible sections, I focus on practical storefront experiences that keep your catalog clear and your store simple to maintain.
benefits: Product, collection and landing page templates
Custom Liquid sections and reusable blocks
Mobile shopping and checkout journey improvements

faq.question: Can you work with my current Shopify theme?
faq.answer: Yes. I can review the current theme and identify changes that can be made without unnecessarily replacing the whole store.

faq.question: Will I be able to manage products?
faq.answer: Yes. Product, price, inventory and collection management stay inside Shopify, with reusable page sections wherever possible.

services.title: Webflow & Wix Development
services.summary: Responsive Webflow and Wix websites with editable CMS collections, flexible page sections and polished interactions.
services.intro: No-code and low-code platforms can still deliver careful, professional experiences. I focus on clear page architecture, well-organized CMS content and responsive design so teams can make updates confidently without losing visual consistency.
benefits: Webflow CMS collections and dynamic pages
Wix page customization and content structure
On-page SEO and mobile experience review

faq.question: Which should I use, Webflow or Wix?
faq.answer: It depends on the design, content structure, team and update workflow. We can review those needs before selecting a platform.

faq.question: Can I add pages without a developer?
faq.answer: Yes, where the platform supports it, CMS templates and reusable sections can make routine publishing much easier.

services.title: CMS Migration & Integrations
services.tagline: Move content without losing the important details.
services.summary: Content migration, CMS restructuring, dynamic content models and integrations that connect your website with the tools you use.
services.intro: Moving a website or changing its content system needs more than copying text. I plan the content structure, map existing URLs, carry over important assets and check the forms, tracking and integrations people rely on.
benefits: CMS fields and dynamic content models

faq.question: Can existing URLs be preserved?
faq.answer: Where practical, yes. When URLs must change, a redirect plan helps visitors and search engines find the new pages.

faq.question: Can existing forms and analytics be retained?
faq.answer: We can review the current setup and map out which integrations should carry over to the new platform.

services.title: CMS Support & Optimization
services.tagline: Keep your site working as it grows.
services.summary: CMS updates, page improvements, accessibility checks, performance optimization and ongoing website support.
services.intro: A good website needs steady care. Whether it is a broken layout, slow loading pages or a new content section, I help make useful improvements while protecting the experience people already know.
benefits: Page speed and Core Web Vitals checks
New sections, forms and feature requests

faq.question: Do you offer one-time fixes?
faq.answer: Yes. Individual fixes and scoped improvements can be handled without requiring a long-term maintenance arrangement.

faq.question: Do you work on existing websites?
faq.answer: Yes. Work can start with an audit of your current CMS, theme, plugins and performance concerns.
